summary: Iter 41 P0 infinite-loop fix — full frontend behavioural testing via Playwright + page.on('request') counters. All P0 criteria PASS. axios interceptor no longer loops on persistent 401s; single-flight refresh confirmed; sidebar polling bounded; SPA-nav dedupe works.
verified_features: P0 NO INFINITE LOOP: With bad token 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.e30.wrong-sig' set before navigation to /marketplace/messages, over 60s: threads=0, refresh=1, /auth/me=2 (React strict-mode double invoke). Token cleared, redirected to /login. Confirms `_retried` guard + wasRefresh-clear branch prevent the previously observed storm.
P0 SINGLE-FLIGHT REFRESH: With bad token, navigating /marketplace (which fires multiple concurrent axios calls via AuthContext + Sidebar + page loaders), refresh=1 exactly. No parallel refresh calls.

P0 REFRESH FAILURE clears token: After bad-token flow (auth/me 401 → refresh 401 → wasRefresh branch), localStorage.sharago_token = null. Confirmed both on /marketplace/messages and /marketplace routes.
P0 REFRESH SUCCESS PATH (valid token): Navigated /garage with fresh demo token — refresh count = 0 over 90s, no unnecessary retry storm. Interceptor's early-return-on-non-401 works.
SIDEBAR 30s POLL: On /garage with valid session, threads endpoint hit 4 times in 90s (1 initial + 3 polls at 30s intervals). Matches expected upper bound.

SIDEBAR SPA-NAV DEDUPE: 5 rapid sidebar-link clicks across marketplace/rentals/swaps/garage/marketplace within ~3s caused 0 additional threads calls — the 15s lastFetchAt gate holds within a single tab session.
REGRESSION: All routes (/marketplace, /garage, /marketplace/messages) load without console errors; login redirect on token clear works normally.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js interceptor is well-scoped: early return on status!==401, dedicated wasRefresh branch, `_retried` config flag ensures at most one retry per original request. Solid.
Note: `_refreshInFlight` is a module-level singleton. A full-page reload (not SPA nav) resets it — but that is inherent to any module state and not a bug.

Sidebar dedupe uses closure-scoped inFlight/lastFetchAt/cancelled — resets on remount within SPA is prevented because the same closure survives across the whole /garage or /marketplace lifetime. Cross-tab dedupe not enforced (would need BroadcastChannel or localStorage lock), but not required for the P0 fix.

Minor: Sidebar.js line 48 uses `.reduce((s, t) => ...)` where `t` shadows the imported `t` from i18n. Non-breaking (no i18n call inside reduce) but a lint-noise/readability risk if future edits add translation lookups in that block.

seed_data_creation: Fresh demo user per run via POST /api/auth/demo (24h TTL).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use page.on('request') + Playwright add_init_script(localStorage.setItem(...)) BEFORE goto to reliably reproduce interceptor scenarios. page.route intercepts axios/xhr but some URL patterns miss on fetch — request event is more reliable for counting. Backend /api/auth/demo, /api/auth/refresh, /api/auth/me all behave correctly. Loop prevention (Iter 41) verified end-to-end.
rca of the issue: Root cause (before fix): interceptor retried EVERY 401 without a per-request flag AND fired a fresh /auth/refresh per concurrent 401. If refresh also 401'd, the retried original request came back 401 → interceptor retried again → infinite loop, saturated by Sidebar's 30s poll + multiple mount cycles. Fix (verified): (a) `cfg._retried` cap = 1 retry, (b) module-level `_refreshInFlight` promise dedupes concurrent refreshes, (c) `wasRefresh` explicit branch clears token when refresh itself 401s. Sidebar defense-in-depth: `inFlight` + `lastFetchAt < 15s` gates.
